description:
About the Position

The ETH AI Center offers a unique fellowship program for doctoral students, designed to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and a positive impact on society. Doctoral fellows conduct AI research at ETH Zurich while benefiting from the Center's community, mentoring and training activities.

The fellowships are among the most competitive AI doctoral awards in Europe and connect fellows with research groups across the full breadth of ETH Zurich - from machine learning foundations to robotics, healthcare, climate and society applications.

Fellowship Benefits

  • Fully funded ETH Zurich doctoral position with a competitive doctoral salary
  • Membership of the ETH AI Center community with mentoring and networking
  • Interdisciplinary training and research-specific skills programmes
  • Participation in Center events, workshops and outreach activities

Eligibility and Requirements

Academic and research preparation
CriterionRequirement
Academic preparationMaster's degree (or equivalent) in computer science, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering or a related field, with a strong AI or machine-learning background; see the official page for the full criteria.
FitMotivation for interdisciplinary AI research and alignment with ETH AI Center faculty research areas.
EnglishGood command of English; ETH Zurich doctoral admission requirements apply.

How to Apply

Submit the application through the official ETH AI Center PhD fellowships page before the 16:00 CET deadline on 27 October 2026. Follow the checklist on the page closely (documents typically include CV, transcripts, research statement and reference details); late or incomplete submissions are not considered.

About the ETH AI Center

The ETH AI Center is ETH Zurich's hub for artificial intelligence research, education and innovation. It brings together researchers across machine learning, robotics, computer vision and AI applications, and runs doctoral and postdoc fellowship programmes that connect researchers across departments.
